versions.content: If UdpNmStayInPbsEnabled is disabled and bus communication in a UdpNm cluster is released and there are no Network Management PDUs on the bus for a configurable amount of time determined by UdpNmTimeoutTime + UdpNmWaitBusSleepTime (both configuration parameters) transition into the Bus-Sleep Mode shall be performed.

If UdpNmStayInPbsEnabled is disabled and bus communication in a UdpNm cluster is released and there are no Network Management PDUs on the bus for a configurable amount of time determined by UdpNmTimeoutTime + UdpNmWaitBusSleepTime (both configuration parameters) transition into the Bus-Sleep Mode shall be performed.

If UdpNmStayInPbsEnabled is disabled and bus communication in a UdpNm cluster is released and there are no Network Management PDUs on the bus for a configurable amount of time determined by UdpNmTimeoutTime + UdpNmWaitBusSleepTime (both configuration parameters) transition into the Bus-Sleep Mode shall be performed.

If UdpNmStayInPbsEnabled is disabled and bus communi- cation in a UdpNm cluster is released and there are no Network Management PDUs on the bus for a configurable amount of time determined by UdpNmTimeoutTime + UdpNmWaitBusSleepTime (both configuration parameters) transition into the Bus- Sleep Mode shall be performed.
